integrity: Proof gives an all-length symbolic identity; finite integer enumerations serve as independent verification and not as an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Ternary alphabet, cyclic adjacent pairs, and off-diagonal support only; not noisy reconstruction or length-three reads. Earlier general Eulerian criteria and all-balanced unrefined generating function are credited.
title: Support-refined enumeration of ternary cyclic dinucleotide profiles
